metadata.description: Red tiles form a closed pysanka egg outline with a central diamond and staggered ornamental stitches. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Split riverbanks surround the motif, with braided channels along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 9 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
